item.name: 05 Create fails after step 2 -> LIFO compensation
item.description: Both steps commit, then a simulated fault forces compensation in reverse order.

exec: const comp = s.steps.filter(x => x.phase === "COMPENSATE" && x.result === "SUCCESS").map(x => x.stepName);
pm.test("Compensations (reverse order): UNASSIGN_BRAND then DELETE_WATCH", () => pm.expect(comp).to.eql(["UNASSIGN_BRAND", "DELETE_WATCH"]));
pm.test("Watch count unchanged (no orphan row left in DBWatch)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.length).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("countBefore"))));
